title: From a Difference of Incomplete Beta Functions to the Stability of Matter
content: We start from a simple question: in what sense is a difference of two regularized incomplete beta functions ``the same'' as the Born rule? The answer is that the difference is the counting statistics of repeated measurements whose single-shot probability $p$ is supplied by the Born rule, and the Born rule is its one-shot special case. Following the single quantity $p(1-p)$, the Bernoulli variance, we then trace a chain of exact correspondences. (i) Canonical anticommutation relations make the fermionic number operator a projector, so the Fermi–Dirac distribution is the Born rule applied to a Gibbs state. (ii) In the microcanonical ensemble the beta function becomes the count of microstates itself. (iii) The exchange holonomy $\pm1$ on the configuration space of identical particles, fixed by spin, propagates as a single sign into distributions, fluctuations, counting statistics and the duality \( g\leftrightarrow-g \) of beta-function multiplicities. (iv) The spin magnitude $\sqrt{s(s+1)}$ is reached from the measured maximum $s$ by one Newton–Raphson step, whose correction is the transverse Born-rule variance. (v) The thermal coordinate $\beta(\varepsilon-\mu)$ is the Mercator latitude of the Bloch sphere. (vi) The logistic equation obeyed by $p$ turns $4p(1-p)$ into a degenerate Weierstrass function whose invariants \( g_2=4/3 \) and $g_3=-8/27$ are fixed by the cusp values\( 2\zeta(4) \) and \( 2\zeta(6) \) of the Eisenstein series $G_4$ and $G_6$. (vii) The same function drives integrable dynamics (KdV, Pöschl–Teller, Calogero–Sutherland). (viii) The ideal gas law is the limit in which $p(1-p)\to p$, quantum statistics enters as a Gaussian exchange correction of width set by the thermal wavelength, and the virial balance of the atom remains stable for many particles precisely because the exchange holonomy is -1. Most individual links are known. The contribution here is to organize them as one chain, together with a few readings we have not seen stated in this form. Every identity has been checked numerically.
